propositions: Extract create recovery logic into binding_recovery.py while preserving the recover_pending_bindings facade signature and behavior at existing call sites
Classify interrupted retirement completion only when tombstone, live forward entry, and live reverse entry agree on exact local_id and Jira key
Completion removes redundant live forward/reverse pair while retaining the tombstone; subsequent completion attempts are no-ops
Any identity mismatch, corrupt live file, or replace failure returns a typed safety abort and retains evidence without automatic invocation
Keyed pending recovery must not perform search; keyless recovery requires both three misses and 3600-second grace window, with single-entry failure not blocking others
Pre-existing create-recovery invocation gate remains guarded solely by if not scoped_ids with no new write-bearing or scope conditions attached
